method: Individual manual inspection of all seven original before/after PNGs; no composite or generated-image substitutions.
observations: Matched desktop street and overhead views show aligned tree pairs along the selected road segment, replacing three scattered background trees.
Junction and mapped path openings remain visible; stems do not visibly occupy carriageways.
Tree-off overhead preserves the underlying road, auditorium and waterside scene; independent asset checks establish unchanged geometry.
Night view preserves row placement; mobile desktop-viewport simulation renders the tree rows with the base tree profile.
limitations: Tree positions, height and spacing are schematic; the captioned reference photo is not geolocated to this exact pilot segment.
Desktop side panel covers the far-left portion of the scene.
Static screenshot debug FPS is not an activity performance result.
Mobile view is a desktop viewport simulation, not a physical-phone check.
Tree profile metadata identifies the selected quality profile, not proof of loading an individual template asset.
